work.description: Building applications for small, medium scale businesses and startups.

projects.name: PartLens
projects.description: A side project I built which allows you to upload 3D .glb files of your machine, then upload manuals and link it to the machines parts, allowing you to share and let users understand how to operate the machine easily

projects.name: Arma Gift Registry
projects.description: Arma Gift Registry is a gift registry platform intended for weddings. I built the entire system from frontend to backend, with an admin panel, while also integrating with payment gateways like onepay.lk for handling payments

projects.name: Markdown Share
projects.description: Markdown share is a opensource markdown sharing platform similar to github gist. It requires no account, has a text editor that lets you create markdown and share them with the world.

projects.name: NoteHub
projects.description: NoteHub was a note managing and collaboration platform that allowed you to create notes, share them. It also featured collaborations allowing you to collaborate with other users by sharing an invite link, version control. It also had other features like following users and make their published notes appear on your feed and more

projects.name: Curiopost
projects.description: Curiopost was a social media platform I built in august 2022. It had a website and was a progressive web app that was installable as a mobile app. It allowed users to create posts and also ask a questions, etc. Curiopost grew to about 100 users until I shut it down a year later. It had a custom for you page algorithm which gives posts based on what the user liked, and more.
